shots.title: Signing in
shots.shows: The sign-in page: one email field, and a passkey option below it.

shots.title: The new game form
shots.shows: The form for a new game — name, venue, day, kickoff time, and squad sizes.

shots.title: Your game
shots.shows: A game with fourteen members, the invite link and QR code, and the fixtures ahead.

shots.title: The invite link
shots.shows: The shareable link and its Copy button, as an organiser sees them.

shots.title: The QR code
shots.shows: The Show the QR code disclosure on the game page, opened, with the QR code for the same invite link inside it.

shots.title: What a player sees
shots.shows: The join page a player reaches from the link: a name and an email, nothing else.

shots.title: Confirming the join
shots.shows: M39: the page the confirmation email's button opens — "Join the squad as Name?" with one button, and nothing written until it's pressed.

shots.title: Arriving from the email
shots.shows: The page a player lands on from the email before they have answered: the game, the time, and two untapped buttons.

shots.title: After you answer
shots.shows: The same page once the player has tapped a button on it: "You're in." above the squad, with both buttons still there to change the answer.

shots.title: The waitlist
shots.shows: A player who answered after the fixture filled, told their waitlist position.

shots.title: Who else is playing
shots.shows: The squad list on the response page, with everyone's name and answer, which is what a player sees while their organiser leaves the default setting on.

shots.title: When it's turned off
shots.shows: The response page for a game whose organiser has turned the setting off: a headcount and the player's own answer, no other names.

shots.title: Changing your mind
shots.shows: A player who has said they cannot make it, and can still change back.

shots.title: Leaving a game
shots.shows: The confirmation page reached from the footer of every email: what leaving does, and the button that actually does it.

shots.title: The squad
shots.shows: Each member's row, with a Manage disclosure that opens to the role button and the remove link.

shots.title: Removing someone
shots.shows: The confirmation page, naming the person and what removing them does.

shots.title: Changing the details
shots.shows: The game's settings, filled in with what it currently uses.

shots.title: Choosing who sees the squad
shots.shows: The Let players see who else is playing checkbox on the edit form, checked because that's the default every game starts with.

shots.title: Choosing what your game sends
shots.shows: The Notifications section of the edit form: one switch per message the game sends, each with the timing it governs, all on by default.

shots.title: Looking somebody up
shots.shows: A squad member's own small page: their name, their email address, whether they're an organiser, and how long they've been in the squad — nothing about what they've played.

shots.title: One fixture, as its organiser sees it
shots.shows: Everyone's answer for one fixture, with an In/Out segment beside each name.

shots.title: Answering for someone
shots.shows: A player marked in by the organiser, with the attribution line naming who did it.

shots.title: A guest for one week
shots.shows: A guest in the squad list, marked as a guest, occupying a slot.

shots.title: Picking the teams
shots.shows: The team picker below the squad on the same fixture page: the two sides named, and every player who is in with three choices beside their name.

shots.title: Calling it off
shots.shows: The cancellation page, with a box for the reason everyone will be told.

shots.title: Your fixtures
shots.shows: A fixture card for a player who is already in, with the buttons they'd use to change their answer.

shots.title: Recording a result
shots.shows: A played fixture's result panel, as a player who was in it sees it: the organiser's claim of a 3–1 score with its one backer, an Agree button to back it, and the form to say something different happened instead.

shots.title: Games you've already played
shots.shows: A game's past fixtures as a player who was in them sees it: one row per game played, most recent first, each linking to that fixture in full.

shots.title: Signing in faster
shots.shows: Where a player adds a passkey so they do not need an emailed link.

shots.title: Your account
shots.shows: A player's own account page: their name in an editable field, then a Signing in section reading out their email address under a small caption, a link to manage passkeys, their last fixtures across every game most recent first, a section offering to install the app, and a Notifications section listing their registered devices.

shots.title: No connection
shots.shows: What the installed app shows if you open it with no signal: a short explanation and nothing that pretends to be live.
